mapper.select: SELECT cr.chatroom_no AS chatRoomNo, cr.chatroom_name AS chatRoomName, (SELECT content FROM ( SELECT content FROM chatting c WHERE c.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no ORDER BY send_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT CASE WHEN TRUNC(send_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN TO_CHAR(send_date, 'AM HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(send_date, 'MM.DD') END FROM ( SELECT send_date FROM chatting c WHERE c.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no ORDER BY send_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS lastTime FROM CHATPARTICIPANT cp JOIN CHATROOM cr ON cp.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no WHERE cp.participant_no = #{userNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT chatting_no AS chattingNo, content, send_user AS sendUser, TO_CHAR(send_date, 'HH24:MI') AS sendDate, chatroom_no AS chatRoomNo FROM chatting WHERE CHATROOM_NO = #{chatRoomNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY SEND_DATE ASC
